visuals.title: From low vitamin D to soft bone

glossary.Defective mineralisation: Failure to lay calcium and phosphate crystals into the bone matrix, leaving it soft.
glossary.Bowing: Outward curving of the long bones of the legs because soft bone bends under weight.
glossary.UV exposure: Sunlight on the skin, which is needed to make vitamin D.
glossary.Insidious: Coming on gradually and subtly, so it is hard to say when it began.
glossary.Symmetrical: Affecting both sides of the body equally.
glossary.Fragility fracture: A fracture from a fall from standing height or less, which a healthy bone would withstand.
glossary.Triad: A group of three features that together point to a diagnosis.
glossary.Hypocalcaemia: A low blood calcium level, which can cause tingling, cramps, tetany and seizures.
glossary.Phosphate: A mineral that combines with calcium to form bone crystal.
glossary.Biochemical: Based on blood test results rather than on imaging or tissue.
glossary.Vitamin D loading: Giving high doses of vitamin D over a few weeks to quickly replace body stores.
glossary.Maintenance: A lower ongoing dose given after the deficiency is corrected, to prevent it coming back.
glossary.Seizures: Episodes of abnormal electrical activity in the brain, causing fits or altered awareness.
glossary.Parathyroid glands: Four small glands behind the thyroid that release PTH when calcium falls.
glossary.Bone resorption: Breakdown of bone by osteoclasts, releasing calcium into the blood.
glossary.Vitamin D receptors: Proteins inside cells, including muscle, that respond to active vitamin D.
glossary.Muscle protein synthesis: The building of new muscle proteins, needed for normal strength.
glossary.Epiphysis: The end of a long bone, separated from the shaft by the growth plate in children.
glossary.Intestinal absorption: Uptake of nutrients such as calcium and phosphate from the gut into the blood.
glossary.Transverse: Running straight across, at right angles to the long axis of the bone.
glossary.Mechanical stress: Force from weight-bearing or muscle pull acting on part of a bone.
